We need to propose a 3-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse: It's a para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to another phenyl with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide linking to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So overall: a sulfonamide linking two phenyl rings, one side has methyl para, other side phenyl with side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-aryl-NH2 (an aniline). So three disconnections suggested: 1) amide formation between carboxylic acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). 2) formation of the α,β-unsaturated acid via Doebner modification from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually Doebner gives α,β-unsaturated acid from aldehyde + malonic acid. So we can disconnect the double bond to aldehyde and malonic acid. 3) sulfonamide formation between sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonylating agent) and aniline (the phenyl sulfonamide). So we need three reactions: sulfonamide formation, Doebner modification, amide coupling.

Thus retrosynthesis steps (reverse order): target -> break amide to give acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Then break double bond to give aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). Then break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the other phenyl with sulfonamide). Actually sulfonamide formed between p-tolyl amine? Wait target has NS(=O)(=O) attached to p-tolyl ring (methyl phenyl) and to second phenyl (c2...). So sulfonamide nitrogen attached to both aromatic rings? Actually NS(=O)(=O)c2... means the sulfonyl group attached to nitrogen which is attached to p-tolyl ring (the N is attached to p-tolyl ring). So sulfonamide formed from p-toluidine (p-methyl aniline) reacting with sulfonyl chloride derived from second phenyl sulfonyl chloride? Wait structure: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(... )cc2)cc1. So the nitrogen is attached to p-tolyl ring (aniline) and sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl. So sulfonamide formation: p-toluidine + aryl sulfonyl chloride (aryl-SO2Cl). So disconnection: break N-S bond to give p-toluidine and aryl sulfonyl chloride (c2ccc(SO2Cl)cc2 with side chain). Then that aryl sulfonyl chloride can be derived from the same aryl with side chain (the unsaturated amide) by converting sulfonyl chloride from sulfonic acid? But we can keep sulfonyl chloride as a building block.

Thus three steps: 1) amide coupling: α,β-unsaturated acid + aniline (c3ccccc3N) -> unsaturated amide. 2) Doebner: aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. 3) sulfonamide formation: p-toluidine + aryl sulfonyl chloride (c2ccc(SO2Cl)cc2) -> target.

We need to provide JSON route with three reaction nodes each with template_id (we need IDs). We need to find appropriate template IDs for each transformation. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria to find templates for amide formation (carboxylic acid to amide), Doebner (aldehyde + malonic acid to α,β-unsaturated acid), sulfonamide formation (aryl amine + sulfonyl chloride to sulfonamide). Let's search.

First amide formation: functional_groups_broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid? The acid is α,β-unsaturated acid (C=CC(=O)O). That's aliphatic carboxylic acid. functional_groups_formed: amide. Use search.
